audience: businesses that send SMS and MMS alerts, reminders and replies through Burst SMS

useCases.title: Send a one-off text to a customer
useCases.text: Send one SMS to one recipient. Check its delivery status with the message id. Each send costs account credit and cannot be recalled.

useCases.title: Send a picture message
useCases.text: Send one MMS with https links to jpg, gif, png, mp3 or mp4 media files. Each send costs account credit and cannot be recalled. Check its status by id.

useCases.title: Trace messages by date or recipient
useCases.text: List sent and received messages by date range, sender, recipient or direction. Open one message to read its status and segment count.

useCases.title: Get replies pushed to your app
useCases.text: Create a webhook that sends SMS_INBOUND events to an https URL you control. Event data includes phone numbers and message text.

useCases.title: Remove a webhook that is no longer used
useCases.text: List the webhooks on the account, read one to check its URL and filter, then delete it. Events stop at once and deletion cannot be undone.
